topics.title: Agentic AI
topics.summary: An agent uses a model in a loop with tools and feedback. Compare complete systems on the same tasks, tools, budget, and success criteria; a model score alone does not measure the whole agent.

topics.title: Model performance
topics.summary: Read scores with the benchmark name, test date, prompting or scaffold, and cost or latency. Rankings from different tasks are not directly interchangeable.

topics.title: Local LLMs
topics.summary: For a locally runnable model, check its model card, license, size, quantization, memory needs, context length, and performance on the task you actually need.

topics.title: AI in research
topics.summary: Track both AI methods used within studies and AI tools used by researchers for literature work, coding, analysis, and writing. Prefer papers and methods sections; record validation, reproducibility, and disclosure.

topics.title: Community views
topics.summary: Reddit, Hacker News, GitHub, and model discussions show user experience and criticism. Treat threads as individual views, not representative surveys or benchmark evidence.
